projects.title: O-Chat — Encrypted LAN Chat
projects.summary: A lightweight C++ chat application for real-time communication over a local network. Users can host or join rooms, exchange encrypted messages, and chat with multiple participants without accounts, cloud services, or saved chat history.
projects.impact: Built a complete multi-client messaging prototype with asynchronous TCP networking, queued message delivery, and AES-256-GCM encryption. Demonstrates practical skills in event-driven architecture, session management, and modular C++ development.

projects.title: CloudForge — 3D Point Cloud Simplification
projects.summary: Built a C++20 desktop application that simplifies recorded 3D point clouds using voxel-grid centroid downsampling. Features synchronized before/after views, sequence playback, voxel inspection, and CPU/CUDA benchmarking.
projects.impact: Reduced one real frame from 55,518 points to 9,943 centroids—82.09% fewer points. A separate 30-frame benchmark measured 4.43× lower median processing latency with CUDA versus the single-threaded CPU reference; all 900 paired output checks passed.
